thread:
maria-cs: Sophie from NovaBank just uploaded a bespoke security questionnaire and marked audit log exports + retention evidence due by end of day Friday. They tried an export and hit 401s. Can we triage? Link: https://files.prod/redwood/q-7z9 (attached by customer)
ticket-bot: New escalation created: CS-4821 — severity: P2 — owner: maria-cs
oliver-security: Thanks Maria. Two quick asks: (1) do we have the customer's KMS key ID and whether they use our managed key or a customer-managed key? (2) need the export request logs (request id + full headers) to see auth failure path.
raj-eng: I'm seeing a cluster of 401s from export-service around 2026-03-08T14:22Z for that org. sample error: "authorization failed: invalid signature". Pasted from logs:
```
2026-03-08T14:22:17Z export svc request_id=987654321 org=nova-bank status=401 err="invalid signature" route=/v1/audit/export
```
maria-cs: Sophie — can you paste the exact steps you used to trigger the export? curl or SDK snippet + time would help.
sophie-customer: hey all — steps below, intermittent 401s, about 1 in 6 attempts fail. curl I used:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export" \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_..." \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"range":{"from":"2026-02-01","to":"2026-03-01"},"format":"ndjson"}'
```
We also tried from their UI which hits the same endpoint, same 401s. Attached full response body from one failure.
oliver-security: Intermittent 401s + "invalid signature" usually indicates key rotation or clock skew between our signer and the HSM reference. Sophie, did you rotate any keys or change your KMS config in last 30 days?
sophie-customer: we rotated an app key last week but not the KMS wrapping key. No changes to KMS config afaik.
raj-eng: Quick check from infra: export-service validates token signature against JWKS fetched from auth-service. If auth-service returned an old jwks during rotation window, clients could see intermittent invalid signatures. I'm going to pull auth-service JWKS logs for the window.
raj-eng: repro command for our internal repro (use test org):
```
X_REQUEST_ID=$(uuidgen)
curl -v -H "X-Request-Id: $X_REQUEST_ID" \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export -d '{"range":{...}}'
```
Include the `X-Request-Id` and send successful + failing attempts and we'll correlate logs.
maria-cs: Oliver — customer is asking for HSM attestation and KMS rotation history to include in their questionnaire. Do we have a standard attestation bundle we can share while engineering investigates the 401 root cause?
oliver-security: Yes we have a standard HSM attestation + key-rotation report. I'll prepare a redacted bundle (no customer PII). Also will include our KMS rotation cadence and last rotation timestamps for relevant keys. ETA: 6 hours.
ethan-cs-manager: Heads up — customer put an internal compliance deadline on Friday COB. If we can't supply the final artifacts, offer interim statement + timeline for final attestation. Maria, offer that as contingency.
maria-cs: Noted. Sophie — we'll share interim attestation and rotation history today, final HSM-rolled attestation within 48 hrs. Meanwhile, can you confirm retention requirement? Their questionnaire asks for 7 years retention for audit logs but our default retention is 3 years for hosted plans.
sophie-customer: They explicitly wrote 7 years in the bespoke form. Their legal team wants evidence of 7-year retention or a signed exception.
oliver-security: We can provide a signed exception template and options: (A) extended retention via archived storage (additional cost + export SLA impacts) or (B) signed statement + contractual addendum. I'll draft language.
raj-eng: For immediate troubleshooting: Maria/Customer please run 10 back-to-back exports with X-Request-Id and send the 401 request IDs. We'll correlate with auth-service and HSM logs. If we confirm jwks rotation window, we can propose a short replay window and a fix in auth-service to reduce jwks TTL.
maria-cs: Action items:
- sophie-customer: run 10 attempts with X-Request-Id, paste failing request ids (owner: sophie-customer) — due: today EOD
- raj-eng: correlate 401 ids with auth-service/jwks/HSM logs (owner: raj-eng) — due: 3 business hours
- oliver-security: prepare interim attestation + rotation report (owner: oliver-security) — due: 6 hours
- maria-cs: send signed exception template and commercial options for 7yr retention (owner: maria-cs) — due: today EOD
maria-cs: I'll update ticket CS-4821 with these owners and ping again after we have the first batch of request ids.
ticket-bot: CS-4821 updated: owners set, priority remains P2, sla timer paused while awaiting customer artifacts.
ethan-cs-manager: Thanks everyone. Keep notes short in the ticket for audit trail. We'll escalate to legal if customer insists on 7yrs without contract amendment — heads up.
